principles.statement: Things act through one path: every write and every MCP call ripples through the ZSEI choke point; registered actors filter it for free; matches become AMT candidates or tasks; paid steps run only in existing loops. Consciousness observes windows-first; the Personal Assistant is its operator-facing voice (derived feed + follow-up tasks) and never calls tools.
principles.rationale: ACTING_LOOP_GUIDE + PERSONAL_ASSISTANT_GUIDE + src/lib.rs boot block. An earlier plan to have the assistant propose browser actions that it then executes was wrong: new MCPs are ripple sources and tool surfaces; if something should react to them it is a RippleActor (free gate) feeding candidates/tasks, and execution stays with the approval-gated task executor and orchestrator.

heuristics.name: Making the system react to a new signal
heuristics.description: Make it a ripple source (it already is if it writes ZSEI/context_mirror); add a RippleActor only where the AMT route does not already cover it; keep evaluate() free and non-semantic.
heuristics.when_to_apply: Any new MCP, sensor or coordination kind.

decision_rules.condition: An agent wants Ozone to perform an action
decision_rules.action: Create a task (Order item); execution goes through the approval-gated executor/orchestrator and /mcp/call; the assistant may remind or propose, not execute.
